items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: And Tony and I, to the last day... he used to come there every night to see me. Tony was a nice guy

ctx.x: And Tony and I, to the last day, you know, he walked on Bourbon Street, he used to come back to the Dream Room when I was at the Dream Room, remember? Mm-hmm. And he said, Santa, I can't walk anymore, so I don't think I'll see him. But he used to be there every night, he used to come there every night to see me. Tony was a nice guy, a lot of musicians, all night Tony, I don't know why.
I always got along with him, he was always very nice to me.
